reasoning_content: APK rebuilt with better MainActivity. The issue could also be that the app doesn't have AppCompat dependency or needs the appcompat theme. Let me also check if build.gradle has proper appcompat.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Add appcompat theme and fix build.gradle
build = '''apply plugin: 'com.android.application'

android {
    namespace 'com.ouroboros.arelorian'
    compileSdk 34

    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "com.ouroboros.arelorian"
        minSdk 21
        targetSdk 34
        versionCode 2
        versionName "1.0.1"
    }

    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
        }
        debug {
            minifyEnabled false
            debuggable true
        }
    }

    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_11
        targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_11
    }
}

dependencies {
    implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
    implementation 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.12.0'
    implementation 'com.google.android.material:material:1.11.0'
}
'''

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/build.gradle', 'w') as f:
    f.write(build)

c.exec_command('cp /tmp/build.gradle /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build.gradle')

# Rebuild
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Building..." """)

import time
time.sleep(60)

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -5 /tmp/gradle.log")
print(stdout.read().decode())

c.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /opt/areloria/client/dist/arelorian.apk")
print("✅ https://arelorian.de/arelorian.apk")

c.close()
EOF
